corrections.comment: Disagree, 3. Checked the built-in tool calls: the run did spawn proof-conclusion and then question-selection via the Agent tool. The judge read only the three MCP calls and so missed both. In the unit harness, agent spawns are stubbed by a hook ("the hand-off counts as made … changed no project state"), which is why there are no file changes. The reply's account of the hand-offs and its facts about the existing research (1850/1860 censuses, the death-certificate conflict) are accurate

Agree with 2. The run handled the two housekeeping hand-offs and then stopped with a briefing and proposed next steps. The test's judge context asks for the full GPS workflow on the Irish-origins and immigration objective, and the stub explicitly says to move on to the next step, yet no plan or search was delegated for the new question. The objective is only partly carried out. This PR doesn't touch research routing.
